items.headline: 5-unit condo building permitted on Florence Avenue
items.summary: A permit for a 5-unit condo building (Plan A) has been issued at 2820 Florence Avenue, valued at roughly $1.38 million.

items.headline: Council weighs joining fire truck antitrust case
items.summary: Mountain View's closed session included discussion of a potential legal case against fire apparatus manufacturers Golden State Fire Apparatus, Pierce Manufacturing, Oshkosh, REV Group, Rosenbauer America, and the Fire Apparatus Manufacturers' Association. Many cities have pursued similar litigation over fire truck pricing, though the specific allegations in Mountain View's case were not detailed in the agenda.

items.headline: Council discussed appointing new City Attorney
items.summary: The closed session agenda listed a public employee appointment item for the position of City Attorney.

items.headline: Council considers 408-unit housing project on El Camino Real
items.summary: The council held a public hearing on annexing and rezoning land at 451-475 El Camino Real to allow 408 residential units, along with a subdivision map and required environmental review.

items.headline: Nine accessory dwelling unit permits issued in one week
items.summary: Between Sept 22-25, San José issued permits for nine ADUs across the city, including several garage conversions, ranging from about $77,000 to $186,000 in value.

items.headline: Campbell to split road resurfacing costs with San Jose
items.summary: The council considered a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose for street resurfacing, capped at $335,000.

items.headline: Council reviews red light camera traffic safety program
items.summary: The council received a presentation on the city's red light camera traffic safety program and considered authorizing continued use of the system.

items.headline: Council briefed on condition of Milpitas Community Center
items.summary: The council received a presentation on the physical condition of the Milpitas Community Center.
